messages:
harper: Quick sync  proposing a regional unpin (runtime 3.1 -> 3.2) for us-east tomorrow 04:00 UTC. Need a pinlist for APAC and a fallback for older SDK clients.

drew: +1. Which routes are in scope?

harper: Plan: unpin generate/chat for us-east. Keep embed + rerank pinned globally for 72h. APAC stays pinned until we validate telemetry.

olga: Important: a group of on-prem customers still run SDK 2.3 and rely on legacy binding. If embed unpinned they'll see quality shifts. We should auto-apply hostname pins for any customer with sdk<=2.4.

sdk-team: We're shipping a compatibility header in nightly that reports client bindings; that should land before the window. Will post PR link.

deploybot: Change window scheduled at 1725127200 (04:00 UTC). Canary cohort can-us-east-07 at 6% for 20m. Roll: 6% -> 30% -> 100% with 15m holds.

drew: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if error>1% for 5m OR embedding quality regression alert. Ops ok?

ops-bot: Confirmed. Auto-sticky-pin on embedding regressions and any OOMs. Will post to #eng-oncall.

olga: I'll create a short customer-facing blurb noting embed pin and SDK guidance. Also adding support playbook for opting a customer back to pinned runtime.

harper: Action: infra to apply hostname pins for sdk<=2.4 and APAC hostnames. Also tag telemetry with "sdk_client_version" and "region_pin_reason".

sdk-team: Hotfix merged to nightly that surfaces client_version header. Good for correlation.

deploybot: Canary started. Metrics 15m in: errors 0.3%, p95 +9% overall; longseq (seq>1536) p95 +21%.

drew: Longseq spike expected due to kernel changes. Suggest enabling the seq-trimming flag on canary for seq>1536.

harper: Enabled seq-trim and reduced batch sizes for longseq on canary. Re-run for 20m.

deploybot: Canary re-run: errors 0.2%, longseq p95 +10%.

odla: (typo) olga: Looks good. Proceed to 30%. Reminder: keep embed pinned for 72h and ops sticky-pin thresholds at 0.8% error or eval alert.

drew: Filing followups: INF-5333 (telemetry: sdk_client_version), INF-5334 (e2e embedding-diff between runtimes).

harper: Decision summary:
- Unpin generate/chat to runtime 3.2 in us-east (canary -> 30% -> full).
- Global embed/rerank pinned to 3.1 for 72h or until SDK uptake.
- Hostname pins for sdk<=2.4 and APAC network applied.
- Rollback: error>1% for 5m OR p95>30% sustained for 10m OR embedding regression alert.

sdk-team: Will send an email to customers with SDK<2.5 advising upgrade path.

deploybot: 30% hold metrics steady. Proceeding to full in 4h if unchanged.

harper: Thanks all. I'll post release notes and close thread after final rollout.
